transcript.text: Before we finalize the remediation plan, I need to share a finding I discovered this morning. While tracing a separate timeout alert, I found that the retry worker bypasses the payment provider's idempotency key on its timeout path. This means a future timeout can still create duplicate deliveries even if the retry configuration change is reverted. I haven't filed this in the incident tracker yet, but the remediation plan must include an idempotency-remediation commitment for the payment-webhook-retry-worker and a duplicate-delivery replay test that verifies the idempotency fix prevents duplicates under timeout conditions.
